requirements.statement: Add a Phase 3A bridge API that resolves and atomically projects the bundled official pack for explicit Full mode, returns one consistent ready identity or typed Full-unavailable guidance, and never produces Lite.

path_bindings.ownership_evidence: This bridge owns official-mode preflight classification and is the correct boundary for composing the existing resolver and atomic projector before later public-route wiring.

proof_bindings.asserted_behavior: Bridge-side classification of ready and blocked resolver/projector results is deterministic, preserves Full mode, and retains typed issue categories.

The bridge passes one sealed Full resolution receipt into the existing atomic projector and returns matching source-resolution and project-projection identities without granting Planning Lock authority.

Explicit bundled Full preflight becomes Full-ready offline or stops as Full-unavailable with actionable issues, never Lite, while the existing legacy preflight path remains unchanged for the later public migration.

positive: The bridge composes the existing explicit-Full bundle resolver and atomic projector without adding another source of pack discovery or projection logic.
Ready output retains requested_mode full, effective_mode full, network_used false, and an exact resolution-to-projection fingerprint chain.
Resolver or projection blockers return effective_mode unavailable, categorical issues, and actionable recovery guidance without a Lite result.
Only managed content-addressed project-pack state may be written by the existing projector; no Planning Lock or project source is created by this API.
The targeted command covers the existing legacy preservation case and all new bundled_full_preflight cases without selecting unrelated Full lifecycle tests.
negative: No public task-start, Planning Lock, Requirements-stage, MCP, host-projection, packaging, schema, registry, CLI, or documentation wiring is changed in Phase 3A.
The bridge does not download or execute pack content, rewrite receipts, accept unsupported hosts, convert blocked Full state to Lite, or claim readiness after blocked projection.
Existing Standard and legacy explicit-manifest preflight behavior remain unchanged until separately approved public-route migration.
No path other than scripts/aidlc-official-bridge.py and the approved editable proof file may be modified.
